concept.name: Mercurio's

menu.name: Margherita Pizza
menu.description: Tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella, basil, and olive oil on a thin crust.

menu.description: Tomato sauce, mozzarella, and crispy pepperoni on a hand-stretched crust.

menu.name: Fettuccine Alfredo
